Macron calls for global stand against 'law of the jungle' at UN

French President Emmanuel Macron, in his final address to the UN General Assembly, urged nations to "stand firm" against an "abuse of power by empires" and a resurgent "law of the jungle." He called for upholding international law and a moratorium on strikes against civilian and energy infrastructure. Macron also criticized Russia, Israel, and, in veiled terms, the United States.
